title: Thai Smoky Chicken Dumpling Bites
description: Crispy Thai-inspired dumplings filled with smoky chicken and cheddar cheese, perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Dumplings
ingredients.notes: Use a round dumpling cutter or the rim of a glass

instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out small squares of dough (about 2 inches per side).
Place a small amount of smoky chicken mixture in the center of each dough square.
Fold the dough squares in half over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a fork to crimp the edges and create a decorative border.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with a beaten egg and sprinkle with jamaican seasoning.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot with a side of cheddar cheese for dipping.
